headline: Serious shoppers
hit a *new low*
slides.fig_caption: Engaged shoppers per Zillow listing in Q3 2026, *down 4.8%* from a year ago
slides.sub: The lowest level since Zillow began tracking the metric in 2023.

slides.title: Where it *fell most*
slides.note: Engagement fell in *44 of the 50* largest metros. Gains were rare, led by Florida: Jacksonville rose 12.2% and Miami 8.7%.

slides.label: average 30-year rate on Oct. 1, up from *6.43%* on July 2
slides.body: On a $400,000 home with 20% down, that lifted the monthly payment from $2,008 to $2,189.

slides.label: engaged shoppers per *starter home*, down 8.2% in a year
slides.body: Luxury listings, the top 5% by value, drew 6.4 shoppers each, flat from last year. Higher-income buyers are feeling rates the least.

slides.title: Buyers have *leverage*
slides.body: Each listing now faces fewer serious buyers. Chicago still draws 4.1 per listing, above the national 3.5. Zillow says sales could rebound quickly if rates fall, so keep your saved-search buyers warm now.
